offers_products.reason: Sells timber logs and manufactures lumber, studs and plywood from its sawmills and plywood mill.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from timber, lumber and land sales, not work done for customers; recreation leases are minor.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells logs and lumber to mills and wholesalers; rural land buyers are a minor part.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells logs, lumber, studs and plywood to mills, lumber dealers and industrial manufacturers such as boat and RV makers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat sales of logs and lumber to the same mills and dealers make up most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Lumber and log demand follows housing and construction, which buyers can cut back in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent, repeated sales of logs and lumber loads, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from owned timberland and manufactured wood products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are sawmills, pulp and lumber wholesalers and building product distributors, mostly sizable companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns over 4 million acres of timberland as a REIT and runs capital-intensive sawmills and a plywood mill.

notes: Website text mixes in legacy PotlatchDeltic mills, so the current balance of timber and wood products is somewhat uncertain.
